title_lines: 巴菲特继任者出手回购
伯克希尔现金布局引关注

subtitles.en: So the fact that we got a decent size buyback and we haven't had a decent size buyback in quite some time from Berkshire, does that mean that suddenly the shares look intrinsically undervalued?
subtitles.zh: 我们进行了一次可观的回购，而伯克希尔已经很长时间没有这样做了，这是否意味着其权益资产突然被低估了？

subtitles.en: Well, they do to Greg Abel at least. He did say at Berkshire's annual meeting in May that they would start engaging in buybacks once they felt that the intrinsic value was above where the market was pricing it.
subtitles.zh: 至少对格雷格·阿贝尔来说是这样。他在五月的年会上表示，一旦他们认为内在价值高于市场价格，就会开始回购。

subtitles.en: And clearly they do think that's the case. They sort of stuck a toe in the water in the first quarter. They bought back about $235 million. Obviously this is a big step up.
subtitles.zh: 显然他们确实这么认为。第一季度他们试了试水，回购了约2.35亿美元，这显然是一个很大的提升。
en_highlights: stuck a toe in the water

subtitles.en: It's still a little bit below what some analysts were hoping, but there is some indication per analyst that they're going that they have been buying back some shares in the current quarter.
subtitles.zh: 这仍略低于一些分析师的预期，但有迹象表明，他们本季度一直在回购权益资产。

subtitles.en: So the stock is up 20% in two years. The S&P in that time is up 45%. I think one of the reasons everyone is so interested in this is because they want to extrapolate and say well that means the broader market is perhaps not overvalued or too overvalued.
subtitles.zh: 该股两年内上涨了20%，同期标普500指数上涨了45%。我认为大家对此如此感兴趣的原因之一是，他们想推断出整个市场可能并未被高估或过度高估。

subtitles.en: Can we extrapolate anything like that from this particular action?
subtitles.zh: 我们能从这一特定行动中推断出什么吗？

subtitles.en: Well, it's with Berkshire, you know, they are sort of a bill whether for the US economy given all of the various business lines that they're in.
subtitles.zh: 对于伯克希尔来说，鉴于其业务线的多样性，它可以说是美国经济的风向标。

subtitles.en: We know for sure that they feel like their own stock is personally a buy.
subtitles.zh: 我们确信他们认为自己的权益资产值得买入。

subtitles.en: They also, this past quarter, bought $20 billion worth of equities, which is the first time they've been net buyers of equities in some time.
subtitles.zh: 此外，上个季度他们购买了价值200亿美元的权益资产，这是他们一段时间以来首次成为净买家。

subtitles.en: So that does seem to indicate that they're finding something of value to buy.
subtitles.zh: 这似乎表明他们找到了值得购买的东西。

subtitles.en: And hopefully we'll know more when we get details of the filing.
subtitles.zh: 希望我们能在文件细节公布后了解更多。

subtitles.en: We will know more when their next quarterly 13F filing is due.
subtitles.zh: 等到下一季度13F文件提交时，我们会了解更多。
